description: Every pair of a..e depends on each other both ways (20 edges), plus a separate x -> y. largest_scc_share = 5/7. Greedy modularity puts a..e in one community and x, y in another: Q = (10/11 - (20/22)^2) + (1/11 - (2/22)^2) = 20/121 = 0.165 <= 0.30. The mud SCC is also a CyclicDependency. a..e all have fan 4/4 and instability 1/2: no hub (fan_in and fan_out sorted 0,1,4,4,4,4,4: Q1 = 2.5, Q3 = 4, fence 6.25), no unstable dependency.
